svg.title: Manufacturing share of GDP at observed anchors: six paths, one shared axis, with visible gaps where the frozen master is silent
svg.desc: A 1280 by 720 classroom-format six-panel dashboard. Each panel plots the frozen World Development Indicators manufacturing-value-added share of GDP (indicator NV.IND.MANF.ZS, current-price, percent of GDP) at observed anchors for one country. All six panels share a 0 to 30 percent vertical axis. Row 1 Africa shows Ghana (terracotta circles, 9.8 percent in 1965 proxy, 9.8 percent in 1990, 11.0 percent in 2020), Botswana (green squares, 11.6 percent in 1965 proxy, 4.8 percent in 1990, 5.7 percent in 2020), and Mauritius (ochre triangles with charcoal keyline, no 1960 observation in NV.IND.MANF.ZS frozen master, 20.4 percent in 1990, 10.7 percent in 2020; connector runs 1990 to 2020 only). Row 2 Asia shows South Korea (blue diamonds with long-dashed connector, 11.4 percent in 1960, 25.2 percent in 1990, 25.7 percent in 2020), Malaysia (jade hexagons, 10.3 percent in 1960 territorial proxy, 24.2 percent in 1990, 22.2 percent in 2020), and the Philippines (red cross with charcoal under-stroke, only 17.7 percent in 2020 is plotted; the 1960 and 1990 historical vintages are shown as separate text annotations and are not connected to the 2020 marker). Ghana 1965 and Botswana 1965 are five-year proxies. Malaysia 1960 is a retrospective territorial series. The 1990 Philippines value of 24.8 percent and the 1960 Philippines value of approximately 18.9 percent are NARRATIVE ONLY historical vintages (Yusuf and Nabeshima 2010; World Bank 1980) and are never connected to the current WDI 2020 observation. 2020 is the COVID-19 pandemic year. Current-price shares reflect price and composition effects. The chart cannot establish whether culture, policy, institutions, war, aid, or another factor caused the gaps. No cross-country ranking is implied. Not a race.
svg.metadata: Chart ID: VIS-008-MANF-16X9. Indicator: NV.IND.MANF.ZS (manufacturing, value added, percent of GDP, current prices). Source: SRC-WDI-001; World Bank (2026), World Development Indicators; WDI API v2 source 2; release 2026-07-13; retrieved 2026-10-06; https://databank.worldbank.org/source/world-development-indicators. Frozen master: data/master/six_country_chart_inputs.csv (15 NV.IND.MANF.ZS rows). Frozen chart CSV: data/charts/manufacturing_share.csv. Specification: design/figures/MANUFACTURING_SHARE_SPEC.md. Frozen full-precision observations (NV.IND.MANF.ZS, percent of GDP): Ghana: 1965=9.75443383356071; 1990=9.76285290799468; 2020=10.9530558483938. Botswana: 1965=11.5853658536585; 1990=4.77075017547342; 2020=5.65905088338406. Mauritius: 1960=not available in NV.IND.MANF.ZS frozen master; 1990=20.3722570941437; 2020=10.6686355036685. South Korea: 1960=11.4035087719298; 1990=25.2385195677477; 2020=25.7002433607737. Malaysia: 1960=10.2609802250256; 1990=24.2246873976537; 2020=22.2320858423886. Philippines: 1960=NARRATIVE ONLY approximately 18.9 percent (World Bank 1980 Part II paragraph 1.11 page 4); 1990=NARRATIVE ONLY 24.8 percent (Yusuf and Nabeshima 2010 Figure 4.16 page 141); 2020=17.6581790478661. Geometry: viewBox 1280x720. Row 1 plot y range 105..305; Row 2 plot y range 368..568. Plot height per row = 200 units. Shared domain 0..30 percent. y = y_baseline - value * (20/3) where y_baseline is 305 (Row 1) or 568 (Row 2). Panel x spans: Panel 1 x=78..455; Panel 2 x=478..855; Panel 3 x=878..1255. Year anchor x positions: Panel 1 (125, 270, 415); Panel 2 (525, 670, 815); Panel 3 (925, 1070, 1215). Plotted marker centres (x, y): Ghana: (125, 239.9704411095953); (270, 239.9143139467022); (415, 231.9796276773747). Botswana: (525, 227.7642276422767); (670, 273.1949988301771); (815, 267.2729941107730). Mauritius: (1070, 169.1849527057087); (1215, 233.8757632875433). No 1960 marker. South Korea: (125, 491.9766081871347); (270, 399.7432028816820); (415, 396.6650442615087). Malaysia: (525, 499.5934651664959); (670, 406.5020840156420); (815, 419.7860943840760). Philippines: (1215, 450.2788063475593). No 1960 marker; no 1990 marker. Narrative-only text anchor x positions on the Philippines panel: 1960 at x=925; 1990 at x=1070. No connector of any kind links these annotations to the 2020 marker. Mauritius 1960 absence note anchor on the Mauritius panel: x=925. The connector between Mauritius 1990 and 2020 stops at the 1990 marker. No cross-country ranking is implied. Country colours and panel order are navigation only.

g.text: SIX COUNTRIES · MANUFACTURING SHARE OF GDP · OBSERVED ANCHORS
Manufacturing share of GDP. Gaps shown, not filled.
Manufacturing value added, percent of GDP, current-price (NV.IND.MANF.ZS). Mauritius 1960 absent; Philippines 1960 and 1990 NARRATIVE ONLY. Not a race.

g.aria-label: Row 1 shared axis: 0 to 30 percent of GDP
Ghana manufacturing share: 9.8 percent in 1965 proxy; 9.8 percent in 1990; 11.0 percent in 2020.
Botswana manufacturing share: 11.6 percent in 1965 proxy; 4.8 percent in 1990; 5.7 percent in 2020.
Mauritius manufacturing share: 1960 not available in NV.IND.MANF.ZS frozen master; 20.4 percent in 1990; 10.7 percent in 2020. Connector runs 1990 to 2020 only.
Row 2 shared axis: 0 to 30 percent of GDP
South Korea manufacturing share: 11.4 percent in 1960; 25.2 percent in 1990; 25.7 percent in 2020.
Malaysia manufacturing share: 10.3 percent in 1960 territorial series; 24.2 percent in 1990; 22.2 percent in 2020.

Philippines manufacturing share: 17.7 percent in 2020. The 1960 value approximately 18.9 percent and the 1990 value 24.8 percent are NARRATIVE ONLY historical vintages from incompatible national-accounts sources and are not connected to the 2020 WDI observation.
Philippines 1960 NARRATIVE ONLY approximately 18.9 percent from World Bank 1980 Part II page 4 NEDA; not connected to the WDI 2020 observation.
Philippines 1990 NARRATIVE ONLY 24.8 percent from Yusuf and Nabeshima 2010 Figure 4.16 page 141; not connected to the WDI 2020 observation.
